title: Introducing Vercel Schedules
summary:
Cron jobs are useful for work that needs to happen regularly. You can use them to do things such as back up your database on a schedule, or keep data in sync between two systems.

You define them once in code and then can update them by editing their config and redeploying. But today, agents interact with users as work evolves, and schedules need to be updated in real time.

We built Vercel Schedules to allow agents and applications to create, change, or cancel one-time and recurring schedules through code, without redeploying.

What are Vercel Schedules?

Schedules builds on the static approach used by Vercel Cron Jobs, but are designed to let users and agents decide when work should happen while your application is still running. A schedule tells Vercel when to trigger a task and where to send it. Your application provides the code that carries out the work.

summary:
When you move from Java 8 to any of Java 11 through 25, the GC the JVM picks when you don't specify one (the default GC) changes from Parallel to G1. A GC is the mechanism that collects the memory of objects no longer in use. Parallel and G1 are names of two kinds of GC.

With this change, container memory (cgroup memory.current) no longer drops after a load peak passes.

I ran the same program under the same load on each version and compared how much container memory changed after the peak1.

Version Change after the peak
Java 8 −234.6 to −227.6MB
Java 11 0.0 to +2.9MB
Java 25 +2.3 to +2.7MB

title: FDE 第 4 课 AI 系统怎么验收：评测集、消融实验、拒答率
summary:
「demo 效果很好」在企业采购里不值一分钱。

因为 demo 时供应商问的是自己挑的问题。专业的 AI 系统验收靠三样东西：

一、评测集（eval set）
上线前先写好一组问题 + 标准答案，覆盖正常问题和「应该拒答」的问题。我做 HR 制度问答时写了 64 条：52 条问答 + 8 条应拒答（问个人工资、问假病假条怎么开、问别家公司制度）。

没有评测集，优化就是玄学——改了一版，好了还是坏了，全靠感觉。

二、消融实验（ablation）
每加一个技术组件，单独测它值多少分。

▪️ v0 框架默认配置：端到端正确率 0.67
▪️ + 按章节切分：0.80
▪️ + 关键词/向量融合（但中文分词有 bug）：0.78 ⬇️
▪️ + 修好中文分词：0.81
▪️ + 元数据过滤（地区/版本）：0.83
▪️ + 拒答 + 表格查表：0.98

看到第三行了吗？加了一个「理论上应该变好」的组件，分数反而掉了——因为框架的中文分词默默失效了。没有消融实验，这个 bug 永远发现不了，系统带病上线。

三、拒答准确率
v0 的拒答准确率是 0.00——8 个不该答的问题全答了。企业场景里，「不该答却答了」比「该答没答出」危险十倍。v1 做到 0.88，剩下的 1 条是「食堂今天有什么菜」这种真歧义，如实标注为已知不足。

验收时怎么问供应商：

  1. 评测集多少条？拒答样本占比？
  2. 能不能给每个组件的消融数据？
  3. 评测结果是不是随代码一起交付、我能复跑？

答不上来的，demo 再好看也别签。

title: SNMPv3 Users Are Scoped to an Authoritative Engine
summary:
SNMPv3 Users Are Scoped to an Authoritative Engine

SNMPv3 is frequently treated as a simple upgrade from community strings. The move from SNMPv1 or v2c does remove cleartext community authentication, but the security model introduces its own identity and state model. A user entry is associated with an authoritative SNMP engine and with keys derived for that engine. An inventory that copies usernames between devices without understanding this relationship can create stale credentials, failed rotation, or unintended access.

The engine ID is part of the identity

RFC 3414 defines the User-based Security Model, or USM. Its security parameters include the authoritative engine ID, engine boots, engine time, and user name. Discovery teaches a manager which engine is authoritative for a device. Authentication and privacy keys are localized to that engine.

How AI Agents Work—and When They Need Human Approval

AI agents are not just chatbots that answer questions. A useful agent has a goal, notices a trigger, reasons about what to do, uses tools, remembers context, and repeats the loop until the task is complete.

title: The SaaS apocalypse started in October
summary:
Using Stripe data across about 181,000 subscription businesses, Mack Grenfell argues the SaaS slowdown became visible in October, when median revenue growth turned negative across most peer groups. He suggests the bigger problem is fewer new signups, likely driven by AI-fueled competition rather than customer churn.
